1 Introduction

2 Getting Started

2.1 Installing and Loading the Required Libraries

  • Package Description
  • The Code

There are 13 packages that will be used in this exercise.

Package Description
tidyverse A collection of R packages for data importing, cleaning, transformation, and visualisation (e.g., readr, dplyr, tidyr, ggplot2).
knitr Provides a general-purpose tool for dynamic report generation in R using Literate Programming techniques.
DT Displays data frames as interactive HTML tables with sorting, filtering, and pagination.
scales Provides graphical scales map data to aesthetics.
ggthemes Provides ‘ggplot2’ themes and scales that replicate some of the famous looks.
readxl Imports excel files into R.
rlang Tools for working with base types, expressions, environments, and especially “tidy evaluation.
plotly Creates interactive and publication-ready graphs.
viridis A dataset and visualisation concept popularised by Hans Rosling. In ggplot and gganimate, Gapminder data is often used as an example to demonstrate animated plots over time, such as countries moving across income and life expectancy.Used here solely to apply its country color scheme.
htmltools Useful tools for creating, manipulating, and writing HTML from R.
timetk A cutting-edge toolkit for time series preparation and exploration.
stringr Provides a consistent and user friendly set of functions for performing common string manipulation tasks, with functions such as str_detect(), str_replace() and str_extract() etc
lubridate A Tidyverse package that handles date-time objects

The code below installs and loads the required packages into R environment.

pacman::p_load(tidyverse, DT, readxl,
             knitr, scales,ggthemes,
               plotly, timetk, lubridate, stringr, htmltools, viridis, rlang, reactable,reactablefmtr)

5 Exploring CPI Contribution Table

aa_compute_yoy_contribution <- function(data, selected_level = 1) {
  latest_date <- max(data$date, na.rm = TRUE)
  prev_year_date <- latest_date %m-% months(12)

  latest_df <- data %>%
    filter(level == selected_level, date == latest_date) %>%
    select(series, level, cpi_latest = cpi)

  prev_df <- data %>%
    filter(level == selected_level, date == prev_year_date) %>%
    select(series, level, cpi_prev = cpi)

  latest_df %>%
    left_join(prev_df, by = c("series", "level")) %>%
    left_join(aa_weights, by = c("series", "level")) %>%
    mutate(
      yoy_pct = (cpi_latest / cpi_prev - 1) * 100,
      contribution_pp = yoy_pct * weight / 10000
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(contribution_pp)) %>%
    arrange(desc(contribution_pp))
}

5.1 Bar Chart

aa_div_contrib <- aa_compute_yoy_contribution(cpi_data, selected_level = 1) %>%
  mutate(
    contribution_pp = round(contribution_pp, 2),
    yoy_pct = round(yoy_pct, 2),
    weight_pct = round(weight / 100, 2),
    contrib_label = sprintf("%.2f", contribution_pp),
    yoy_label = sprintf("%.2f", yoy_pct),
    weight_label = sprintf("%.2f", weight_pct)
  )

plot_ly(
  data = aa_div_contrib,
  x = ~contribution_pp,
  y = ~reorder(series, contribution_pp),
  type = "bar",
  orientation = "h",
  text = ~contrib_label,
  texttemplate = "%{text}",
  textposition = "inside",
  hovertext = ~paste0(
    "<b>", series, "</b>",
    "<br>YoY: ", yoy_label, "%",
    "<br>Weight: ", weight_label, "%",
    "<br>Contribution: ", contrib_label, " pp"
  ),
  hovertemplate = "%{hovertext}<extra></extra>"
) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Contribution to CPI by Division",
    xaxis = list(title = "Contribution (percentage points)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "")
  )

5.2 Reactable with Sparklines

latest_date <- max(cpi_data$date, na.rm = TRUE)
start_12m <- latest_date %m-% months(11)

aa_spark <- cpi_data %>%
  filter(level == 1, date >= start_12m, date <= latest_date) %>%
  arrange(series, date) %>%
  group_by(series) %>%
  summarise(trend_12m = list(cpi), .groups = "drop")

aa_table <- aa_div_contrib %>%
  left_join(aa_spark, by = "series") %>%
  mutate(
    weight_pct = weight / 100,
    yoy_pct = round(yoy_pct, 2),
    contribution_pp = round(contribution_pp, 2)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(contribution_pp))

aa_table %>%
  reactable(
    defaultPageSize = 10,
    defaultSorted = "contribution_pp",
    defaultSortOrder = "desc",
    striped = TRUE,
    highlight = TRUE,
    bordered = TRUE,
    compact = TRUE,
    columns = list(
      cpi_latest = colDef(show = FALSE),
      cpi_prev = colDef(show = FALSE),
      weight = colDef(show = FALSE),

      series = colDef(
        name = "Division",
        minWidth = 220
      ),

      weight_pct = colDef(
        name = "Weight (%)",
        align = "right",
        format = colFormat(digits = 2)
      ),

      yoy_pct = colDef(
        name = "YoY %",
        align = "right",
        cell = function(value) {
          color <- if (is.na(value)) {
            "#666"
          } else if (value > 0) {
            "#b22222"
          } else if (value < 0) {
            "#1f77b4"
          } else {
            "#444"
          }

          div(
            style = paste0("color:", color, "; font-weight: 600;"),
            ifelse(is.na(value), "NA", sprintf("%.2f%%", value))
          )
        }
      ),

      contribution_pp = colDef(
        name = "Contribution (pp)",
        align = "left",
        cell = function(value) {
          bar_width <- min(abs(value) * 90, 120)
          bar_color <- if (is.na(value)) {
            "#999999"
          } else if (value > 0) {
            "#d73027"
          } else if (value < 0) {
            "#4575b4"
          } else {
            "#999999"
          }

          div(
            style = "display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;",
            div(
              style = paste0(
                "height:14px; width:", bar_width, "px; background:", bar_color,
                "; border-radius:4px;"
              )
            ),
            div(ifelse(is.na(value), "NA", sprintf("%.2f", value)))
          )
        }
      ),

      trend_12m = colDef(
        name = "12M Trend",
        minWidth = 160,
        cell = react_sparkline(
          aa_table,
          height = 45,
          show_line = TRUE,
          line_color = "black",
          show_area = FALSE,
          highlight_points = highlight_points(
            first = "red",
            last = "blue"
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )

5.3 12 Month Trend Data

latest_date <- max(cpi_data$date, na.rm = TRUE)
dashboard_start <- latest_date %m-% months(12)

cpi_dashboard <- cpi_weighted %>%
  filter(
    date >= dashboard_start,
    date <= latest_date,
    level %in% c(1, 2, 3),
    !series %in% c(
      "All Items Less Accommodation",
      "All Items Less Imputed Rentals For Housing"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    weight_pct = weight / 100
  ) %>%
  group_by(level, division, group, class, series) %>%
  arrange(date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    cpi_prev = lag(cpi, 12),
    yoy_pct = (cpi / cpi_prev - 1) * 100,
    contribution_pp = yoy_pct * weight / 10000
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
aa_latest_date <- max(cpi_dashboard$date, na.rm = TRUE)
aa_start_12m <- aa_latest_date %m-% months(11)

aa_spark <- cpi_dashboard %>%
  filter(
    level == 1,
    date >= aa_start_12m,
    date <= aa_latest_date
  ) %>%
  arrange(series, date) %>%
  group_by(series) %>%
  summarise(
    trend_12m = list(cpi),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

aa_latest <- cpi_dashboard %>%
  filter(
    level == 1,
    date == aa_latest_date
  ) %>%
  select(series, cpi, yoy_pct, contribution_pp, weight_pct) %>%
  mutate(
    yoy_pct = round(yoy_pct, 2),
    contribution_pp = round(contribution_pp, 2),
    weight_pct = round(weight_pct, 2)
  ) %>%
  left_join(aa_spark, by = "series") %>%
  arrange(desc(contribution_pp))

aa_latest <- aa_latest %>%
  select(series,cpi, trend_12m, yoy_pct, weight_pct, contribution_pp)

aa_latest %>%
  reactable(
    .,
    defaultPageSize = 10,
    defaultSorted = "contribution_pp",
    defaultSortOrder = "desc",
    compact = TRUE,
    bordered = FALSE,
    striped = FALSE,
    highlight = TRUE,
    defaultColDef = colDef(
      align = "center"
    ),
    columns = list(
      series = colDef(
        name = "Division",
        minWidth = 150,
        align = "left"
      ),
     cpi = colDef(
        name = "CPI",
        format = colFormat(digits = 2),
        minWidth = 65
      ),
      trend_12m = colDef(
        name = "12M Trend",
        minWidth = 260,
        cell = react_sparkline(
          .,
          height = 55,
          show_line = TRUE,
          line_color = "black",
          bandline = "innerquartiles",
          bandline_color = "lightblue",
          statline = "mean",
          statline_color = "grey",
          statline_label_size = "0.7em",
          highlight_points = highlight_points(
            min = "black",
            max = "black"
          )
        )
      ),

      yoy_pct = colDef(
        name = "YoY %",
        minWidth = 60,
        cell = function(value) {
          color <- if (is.na(value)) {
            "#666"
          } else if (value > 0) {
            "#b22222"
          } else if (value < 0) {
            "#1f77b4"
          } else {
            "#444"
          }

          div(
            style = paste0("color:", color, "; font-weight: 600;"),
            ifelse(is.na(value), "NA", sprintf("%.2f", value))
          )
        }
      ),

      weight_pct = colDef(
        name = "Weight (%)",
        format = colFormat(digits = 2),
        minWidth = 75
      ),

      contribution_pp = colDef(
        name = "Contribution",
        minWidth = 140,
        align = "right",
        cell = function(value) {
          bar_width <- min(abs(value) * 120, 140)
          bar_color <- if (is.na(value)) {
            "#bdbdbd"
          } else if (value > 0) {
            "#d73027"
          } else if (value < 0) {
            "#4575b4"
          } else {
            "#bdbdbd"
          }

          div(
            style = "display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:flex-end; gap:8px;",
            div(
              style = paste0(
                "height:12px; width:", bar_width, "px; ",
                "background:", bar_color, "; ",
                "border-radius:6px; opacity:0.8;"
              )
            ),
            div(
              style = "min-width:45px; text-align:right;",
              ifelse(is.na(value), "NA", sprintf("%.2f", value))
            )
          )
        }
      )
    )
  )
